sourceRules.Canonical: Canonical sources must be cited and verified separately from interpretation.
sourceRules.Interpretation: Label interpretation and preserve its source lineage.
sourceRules.Fiction: Original fiction; never present invented text as scripture.

editorialPolicies.cast: Cast is selected from data and frozen by revision; assets require separate approval.

terminology.subject: Event, person, place or historical method
terminology.swarajya: Historical political concept; contextual meaning requires sources, not a slogan
terminology.chhatrapati: Royal title; preserve transliteration and context

sourceRules.Historical: Early twentieth-century secondary histories, not neutral consensus or independent contemporary eyewitness records. Retain attribution; do not reproduce ethnic/religious stereotypes as facts. Verify OCR against scans before public use.
sourceRules.SourceQuotation: Exact attributed historical account excerpt; not Sanskrit or scripture.
sourceRules.HistoricalClaim: Two-work technical corroboration only; human factual assessment required.
sourceRules.PopularLegend: Narrated as a legend in the source; never established as miraculous historical fact.
sourceRules.Fiction: Original invented archive-guide dialogue; no impersonation or invented words attributed to historical people.

editorialPolicies.review: Human historical/editorial review required for public release; private technical fixtures remain explicit.
editorialPolicies.timeline: Source years CE; do not infer Gregorian conversion, exact birth date, timezone or precision absent in evidence
editorialPolicies.disagreement: The selected Kincaid passage reports and disputes Grant Duff; direct Duff verification remains pending. The disagreement is not silently settled.
editorialPolicies.rights: Selected permitted original text only; no portraits, footage, modern additions or historical voice cloning.
editorialPolicies.cast: One fictional archive guide; historical people are subjects, not impersonated speakers.

characters.biography: Original fictional guide who asks learners to check sources and uncertainty; not a historian or historical person.
